{{Quote|You will pay for your actions!|Jedi Padawan to [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]|<ref name="Star Wars Episode III: Revenge of the Sith video game" />}}
This [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] was a [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. As the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] was drawing to an end, she was inside the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] library when she witnessed [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] enter with two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. She watched in horror when Skywalker, who had turned to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] and became the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] Darth Vader, brutally murdered [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Jocasta Nu/Legends|Jocasta Nu]]. Along with other Jedi in the room, she tried to avenge Nu's death, but was slain by Vader which led to the beginning of the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Great Jedi Purge]].
